text: Hey Tamar, depends on branch timing but also since the war it can take longer. We did it 1.5 years ago and we got the answers immediately in Tel Aviv. However for the A5 I had to wait 6 months. For the birth certificate, if it’s what they gave you in the government you will need to get APOSTILLE back in the original country to certify it. Unfortunately, much of the process is left to the clerks own opinion and there is no clear regulation. I had the same issue with a UK valid police check.
